cases.name: frame mismatch
cases.why: the terrain and the layout must declare the identical horizontal frame; no transformation is attempted

cases.name: vertical datum mismatch
cases.change: T09 inputs (surface vertical = orthometric EPSG:5773) with request.expected_vertical = {kind: orthometric, crs: EPSG:5703}
cases.why: no vertical transformation in Module 02 (PROJ falls back to a no-op ballpark transformation offline; see research/library-probes.json)

cases.name: vertical kind mismatch
cases.change: T03 (local datum local:fixture-datum) with request.expected_vertical = {kind: local, id: local:other-benchmark}
cases.why: a different local benchmark is a different reference

cases.name: empty expected_vertical
cases.why: assertions must be complete

cases.name: partial expected_vertical
cases.why: kind without crs is not a supported assertion

cases.name: matching expected_vertical
cases.change: T09 with request.expected_vertical = {kind: orthometric, crs: EPSG:5773}
cases.why: accepted; result identical to T09 except parameters_digest and placement_id

cases.name: missing vertical datum
cases.why: elevations without a declared vertical reference are not accepted

cases.name: source mismatch
cases.why: a placement names the layout by result_id and payload_digest together

cases.name: degenerate triangle
cases.why: zero plan area

cases.name: overlapping triangles
cases.why: a 2.5D surface maps each plan point to one elevation

cases.name: clockwise triangle
cases.why: orientation is part of the contract (counter-clockwise in plan)

cases.name: duplicate plan vertex
cases.why: two elevations at one plan point

cases.name: cracked T-junction
cases.why: the edge (8,0)-(4,4) interpolates to 10.3 at (6, 2) on one side and the junction vertex says 10.5: a crack with two elevations along one line

cases.name: too many triangles
cases.change: a surface with more triangles than the configured limit (tests lower the limit; the T1 limit is 2,000,000)
cases.why: checked before geometric work

cases.name: placement time limit
cases.why: finite time limit; nothing stored

cases.name: unsupported support model
cases.why: generated rows are T2

cases.name: support outside footprint
cases.why: supports are inside the table footprint

cases.name: unsupported policy
cases.why: reorientation is a later, separately approved milestone

accepted_variants.name: consistent T-junction
accepted_variants.expected: valid surface; see case T12 (T03 placement unchanged, L = 11.1 m)
